_meta.note: The corpus of each study, as the data platform would hold it, and what the analyst checks before reading it in the Explorer. Fictional figures and verbatims, written for the prototype (AI-assisted): illustrative only, to review before any client-facing use. Ratios, cost and durations are placeholders until the data platform gives real ones.
